text:
The median asking rent in Brunswick sits at 9.78 €/m², with a slight year‑on‑year dip of 0.1 % but a solid five‑year gain of 16.5 %. The 25th‑percentile is 8.52 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 11.0 €/m², placing the city 28th of the 37 most expensive markets.

Market tightness remains balanced: properties stay on the market for about 29 days and only 24 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 2.3 % and rent burden for a two‑person household is 12.7 % of income, while asking rents sit roughly 34 % above existing rents (7.27 €/m²).

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to rise to 10.22 €/m² in 12 months, within a range of 9.98 – 10.56 €/m², implying a 4.5 % increase.
